pos.personaBrief: Barcelona (61% in the 2015 final) and PSG ('we prefer to keep the ball', 2026) are possession-based, but with a vertical edge and counters (Scotsman 2016, TFA 2024), and he admits adapting when the opponent is better.

pro.personaBrief: Positional play with verticality: PSG seek verticality from a centre-back or full-back (CulturePSG 2025), long balls to the wings and incisive counters, yet goalkeeper-led build-up against pressing (Sports Mole 2025) and calm possession turning into full-throttle attack (Sportskeeda 2015).

est.personaBrief: Structured jeu de position 3-2-2-3 with five inside and five outside players (CulturePSG 2025), defined roles and wide wingers, but with fluid rotations and a false-nine style forward dropping out (TFA 2024).

lar.personaBrief: Wide forwards hold width (Coaches' Voice 2025, Kvaratskhelia), five outside players around the block, attack the wings first in the final; Barcelona with the MSN front three and full-backs providing width.

blo.personaBrief: PSG press player-to-player from the front against build-up (Coaches' Voice 2025, Sports Mole), the front line leads the press, Barcelona pressed Juventus and recovered the ball quickly (SI/PlayingFor90 2015); deep block only as adaptation.

mar.personaBrief: Mixed evidence: Barcelona moved set pieces from zonal to man (Bleacher Report 2014), PSG use a mixed zone with free players and abandoned the zone-near-goal plus individual system (CulturePSG 2024), open-play pressing is player-to-player, with no fixed individual reference ('aucun repere individuel fixe').

pla.personaBrief: Strong own identity: 'tenemos muy clara la idea y no la vamos a cambiar', imposes his model on arrival (Barcelona, PSG after Mbappe), though he adapts defensively against better sides (beIN 2026) and the score dictates risk.

res.personaBrief: Attack-minded ('juego de ataque', 'lo que menos me preocupa es el resultado'), team keeps attacking when ahead, but he demands trophies and a way of winning; prefers to keep playing rather than shut the game.

sis.personaBrief: 'Stars are in function of the team, not the other way round' (2025), effort over ego, Dembele benched for lateness, no fixed individual freedom; system-first with rotation.

jog.personaBrief: Technical positional play with players who dribble directly at pace; demands intensity and pressing effort, wants a ball-playing pivot (Vitinha deep), little concern with aerial duels.

bas.personaBrief: Barcelona 2014-17 built with signings (six in summer 2016, Rakitic over Fabregas), PSG with the youngest squad in the last 16 yet won the title with proven stars and signings; picks on form and fit, not age or academy.

lid.personaBrief: The 'Iron Fist': fined players for being a minute late (Sportskeeda), benched Dembele for lateness ('best decision of the season'), falling out with Messi; softened somewhat at Barcelona but rules apply to all stars.
